call.x: The Opportunity As energy systems face growing operational, environmental and security challenges, ensuring the resilience of Europe's electricity grids is becoming increasingly important. This is driving demand for innovative solutions that can help grid operators anticipate, detect and respond to disruptions, while maintaining a secure and reliable energy supply. This Call for Proposals is conducted in collaboration with ENTSO-E, the European Network of Transmission System Operators for Electricity. As part of ESA’s Task Force for Innovation in Energy Through Space, ENTSO-E has consolidated a representative set of generic operational challenges for electricity transmission networks,...

HE-GA-B.title: Horizon Europe Work Programme 2026-2027, General Annexes, B - Eligibility

consortium.quote: Unless otherwise provided for in the specific call/topic conditions, only legal entities forming a consortium are eligible to participate in actions provided that the consortium includes, as beneficiaries, three legal entities independent from each other and each established in a different country as follows: – at least one independent legal entity established in a Member State; and – at least two other independent legal entities, each established in different Member States or Associated Countries.
